events.n: chromist; lithograph created after the original work
events.q: The lithographs were meticulously created after the original works (Oil Paintings, Watercolors, Pastels, Charcoal Drawings, etc.) by Master Chromist Marcel Salinas

events.n: printing authorized by Picasso's granddaughter after his death (Picasso Estate Collection)
events.q: After Pablo Picasso's death in 1973, his granddaughter Marina authorized the printing of these original lithographs
